tasks.label: MCP: Start Server (stdio)
tasks.detail: Run the MCP server over stdio. For local clients (VS Code MCP config, Claude Desktop) the client spawns this process itself, so this task is mainly useful for manual testing.

tasks.label: MCP: Start Server (streamable-http)
tasks.detail: Long-running HTTP MCP server on http://127.0.0.1:8000/mcp. Starts automatically when the folder is opened; connect a remote client to that URL.
